create_LinearModelLoss: create a LinearModelLoss instance to compute loss, gradient, and hessian for linear models with L2 regularization
compute_sandwich_dot: compute the sandwich product X.T @ diag(W) @ X for hessian approximation in linear model solvers
init_zero_coef: initialize zero coefficients with correct shape for univariate or multiclass linear models
compute_loss_gradient: compute loss and gradient with respect to coefficients for linear models with sample weights and L2 regularization
compute_gradient_hessian: compute gradient and full hessian matrix for linear models including multiclass categorical cross-entropy
